content.title: AEIS Q3 Deep Dive: Data Center Growth and Manufacturing Investments Drive Results
content.summary: Manufacturing equipment and systems provider Advanced Energy (NASDAQ:AEIS) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 23.8% year on year to $463.3 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($470 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 5.5% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.74 per share was 18.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
